peopleAlsoAsk.question: How to write a customer case study?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet:
Choose the right story—not just any win

 Not every customer success makes a good case study. Yes, big logos help. But a “happy customer” with generic outcomes won't resonate. What you want is a story that reflects a clear problem, a thoughtful solution, and real change.
